May 18, 2018 - By Vivian Park
Jonathan Soros increased its stake in Alibaba Group Hldg Ltd (BABA) by 8.47% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Js Capital Management Llc bought 5,000 shares as the company’s stock rose 3.18% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Jonathan Soros held 64,000 shares of the business services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $11.04 million, up from 59,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Js Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Alibaba Group Hldg Ltd for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $503.67 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.05% or $2.09 during the last trading session, reaching $196.02. About 13.47 million shares traded. Alibaba Group Holding Limited (NYSE:BABA) has risen 68.29% since May 18, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 56.74% the S&P500.
Glg Llc increased its stake in Starbucks Corp (SBUX) by 14.93% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Glg Llc bought 10,000 shares as the company’s stock rose 0.28% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund held 76,960 shares of the restaurants company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $4.42M, up from 66,960 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Glg Llc who had been investing in Starbucks Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $78.94B market cap company. The stock increased 0.09% or $0.05 during the last trading session, reaching $57.2. About 5.05M shares traded. Starbucks Corporation (NASDAQ:SBUX) has risen 0.40% since May 18, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 11.15% the S&P500.
